UserPromptSubmit.name: user-prompt-guard
UserPromptSubmit.description: Blocks prompts containing AWS secrets, access keys, or credentials from being submitted to the model

PreToolUse.name: pre-tool-guard
PreToolUse.description: Prevents destructive operations: terraform destroy, rm -rf, bucket deletion without explicit confirmation

PostToolUse.name: post-tool-logger
PostToolUse.description: Logs all tool executions with timestamps, tool name, and exit codes to .claude/logs/tool-usage.log
